observations.source_title: Amana Tool 2 Flute Solid Carbide Spiral Plunge with Corner Radius Router Bit (speed chart)

observations.material_label: Soft Wood (Amana chart column); Amana 46460, 1/4 in diameter, 2 flute solid carbide spiral plunge with corner radius
observations.ap_rule: Depth of Cut: 1 x D Use recommended chip load; 2 x D Reduce chip load by 25%; 3 x D Reduce chip load by 50% (chart footnote)
observations.notes: Printed row, transcribed 2026-09-24 from the stored text sources/amana_corner_radius_spiral_plunge.txt (A3 step 4, G3; fetch record planning/extrapolation_2026-09-24/fetch/G3/verified_rows.json). The chart prints the 1/4 in row (tool ref 46460) with 2 flutes, 18,000 RPM and a depth of cut of 1 x D. The chart names no operation and no pass role. The file holds one row per printed cell; the G3 family rule serves the other families (feeds::extrapolation::family, ruling A3): the row is filed under the home family pocket (pass_role roughing), and the rule serves the adaptive, contour, parallel, scallop and trace families from it at x1.00. No row is copied into another family. The chart prints Soft Wood, Hard Wood, MDF, Plastics and Aluminum columns and no plywood column. Derived, not printed: the chart does not print the corner radius or the word 'up-cut'. The corner radius 0.0625 in (1/16 in) and 'up-cut' come from the Toolstoday product pages, which are not stored and have no hash. The schema has no corner-radius field. hardness_value is the engine's Janka proxy for this material family (GenericSoftwood 600, GenericHardwood 1450, MDF 1100); the chart prints no hardness. The ZrN (46460-Z) and Spektra (46460-K) copies of the chart print the same wood values at 1/4 in, and the Spektra copy also at 1/2 in; their footnote says 'Reduce feed rate' where this chart says 'Reduce chip load'.
